info.name: PAYFLOW AI - Official REST API Collection
info.description:
Authoritative Postman API Collection for PAYFLOW AI — an AI-powered accounts receivable assistant for freelancers and small businesses.

Features:
- Authentication (Argon2id + JWT)
- Customer CRUD with deduplication
- Invoice drafting with server-authoritative Decimal math
- Human Approval Center with cryptographic snapshot binding
- PayPal Developer Sandbox Invoicing v2 adapter
- AI Assistant with structured tool calling & natural language invoice extraction
- Aging receivables analytics and multi-currency metrics
- Automated reminder policy engine & Zapier notification webhooks
- PayPal Webhook cryptographic signature verification
- Append-only-style audit trail and financial ledger

Security Invariant: Credentials and tokens are managed via collection variables. No secrets are embedded in this collection.

item.name: 11 - PayPal Webhook Ingestion
item.description:
Official PayPal Webhook receiver. CRITICAL SECURITY INVARIANT: This endpoint cryptographically verifies signatures against PayPal's REST API. A manually posted JSON body without official PayPal headers will be rejected (HTTP 400/401).

TO TEST LIVE SANDBOX WEBHOOKS:
1. Open PayPal Developer Dashboard > Webhook Simulator (https://developer.paypal.com/dashboard/webhooksSimulator)
2. Set Webhook URL to: <Your-Public-URL>/api/webhooks/paypal
3. Select Event Type: INVOICING.INVOICE.PAID or PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED
4. Click 'Send test'
5. The simulator transmits authentic headers and signature, which PayFlow cryptographically verifies and reconciles.

request.description: Receives PayPal webhook events. Cryptographically verifies signatures. Notice: Must include authentic PayPal cryptographic headers: PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO, PAYPAL-CERT-URL, PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID, PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG, PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME.
